body_markdown:
CLEVELAND, OH (Apr 28, 2026) — Massimo saw strong interest from municipal, county and commercial fleet operators at the NAFA 2026 Institute & Expo in Cleveland, Ohio.


Most of that interest centered on two lines:


- **Sentinel Series UTVs** with factory-integrated heating and air conditioning.
- **MVR Pro Series electric carts** for campuses, facilities and industrial sites.


Both are built for all-weather, high-frequency use in public works, infrastructure maintenance, campus operations and industrial facilities. Massimo also recently delivered vehicles to a major global automotive manufacturer to support internal logistics and facility operations.


"We saw strong engagement at NAFA from fleet operators actively evaluating solutions that can perform reliably across a wide range of operating conditions," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo. "Our HVAC-equipped Sentinel Series UTVs and MVR Pro Series electric carts are designed to meet these demands."
